summary: Episode 28: Using paper scraps left over from copying books for the reading circle, Tariq built a kite and launched it from the workshop roof, only to crash it into the courtyard fig tree. Instead of scolding him, Salim helped him rebuild it lighter and taught him that reaching the sky means being willing to fall first — every setback is a lesson from the One who made the heavens. At dusk the mended kite soared over the lantern district, and Noor watched it from her bakery doorway. She still doesn't know who leaves the gifts at her door.
open_threads: Noor still doesn't know who leaves the anonymous gifts at her door (Tariq knows it is Salim)
